import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
P = 'W083_mixed_{{wright.run_id}}_r3_'
out = 'C:\\Users\\markb\\.codex\\visualizations\\2026\\09\\24\\01a0d4b8-b5fa-79d0-8e8b-fc78c3dfd056\\t047-fresh-prompt-055\\process-proofs\\printed-replacement-part\\mixed-default-071\\outputs\\{{wright.run_id}}\\source_mesh.stl'
if any((o.name.startswith(P) for o in bpy.data.objects)):
    raise RuntimeError('Owned-name collision; refusing overwrite')
bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'
bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.length_unit = 'MILLIMETERS'
bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.scale_length = 0.001

def active(o):
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    o.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = o

def apply_mod(o, m):
    active(o)
    bpy.ops.object.modifier_apply(modifier=m.name)

def boolean(o, c, op):
    m = o.modifiers.new(P + op, 'BOOLEAN')
    m.operation = op
    m.solver = 'EXACT'
    m.object = c
    apply_mod(o, m)
    bpy.data.objects.remove(c, do_unlink=True)

def join_owned(obs, name):
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    for q in obs:
        q.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obs[0]
    bpy.ops.object.join()
    obs[0].name = name
    return obs[0]
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=192, radius=19.0, depth=16.0, location=(0, 0, 8.0))
body = bpy.context.object
body.name = P + 'focus_wheel'
cs = []
for i in range(6):
    a = math.radians(60 * i)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=96, radius=8.0, depth=20.0, location=(24.75 * math.cos(a), 24.75 * math.sin(a), 8.0))
    q = bpy.context.object
    q.name = P + 'scallop_%02d' % i
    cs.append(q)
cut = join_owned(cs, P + 'scallop_cutters')
boolean(body, cut, 'DIFFERENCE')
bev = body.modifiers.new(P + 'body_R1', 'BEVEL')
bev.width = 1.0
bev.segments = 4
bev.limit_method = 'ANGLE'
apply_mod(body, bev)
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=128, radius=6.0, depth=2.2, location=(0, 0, 16.9))
hub = bpy.context.object
hub.name = P + 'hub'
hb = hub.modifiers.new(P + 'hub_R1', 'BEVEL')
hb.width = 0.95
hb.segments = 4
hb.limit_method = 'ANGLE'
apply_mod(hub, hb)
features = [hub]
cap_h = 0.35
cap_a = 0.6
cap_R = (cap_a * cap_a + cap_h * cap_h) / (2 * cap_h)
cap_z = 16.0 + cap_h - cap_R
for n in range(6):
    for s in (-8.0, 8.0):
        a = math.radians(30.0 + 60.0 * n + s)
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(segments=24, ring_count=12, radius=cap_R, location=(13.5 * math.cos(a), 13.5 * math.sin(a), cap_z))
        q = bpy.context.object
        q.name = P + 'dot_%02d_%s' % (n, 'm' if s < 0 else 'p')
        features.append(q)
feat = join_owned(features, P + 'raised_features')
boolean(body, feat, 'UNION')
r = 3.2
xf = -2.4
aa = math.acos(xf / r)
pts = []
N = 96
for i in range(N + 1):
    t = -aa + 2 * aa * i / N
    pts.append((r * math.cos(t), r * math.sin(t)))
verts = [(x, y, -0.5) for x, y in pts] + [(x, y, 10.0) for x, y in pts]
n = len(pts)
faces = [tuple(range(n - 1, -1, -1)), tuple(range(n, 2 * n))]
for i in range(n):
    j = (i + 1) % n
    faces.append((i, j, n + j, n + i))
me = bpy.data.meshes.new(P + 'socket_mesh')
me.from_pydata(verts, [], faces)
me.update()
sock = bpy.data.objects.new(P + 'socket_cutter', me)
bpy.context.collection.objects.link(sock)
boolean(body, sock, 'DIFFERENCE')
tri = body.modifiers.new(P + 'triangulate', 'TRIANGULATE')
apply_mod(body, tri)
active(body)
bm = bmesh.new()
bm.from_mesh(body.data)
nonman = sum((1 for e in bm.edges if not e.is_manifold))
vol = abs(bm.calc_volume(signed=True))
bm.free()
if nonman:
    raise RuntimeError('Geometry failure: %d non-manifold edges; export refused' % nonman)
tris = len(body.data.polygons)
if tris > 80000:
    raise RuntimeError('Triangle limit exceeded: %d' % tris)
world = [body.matrix_world @ Vector(c) for c in body.bound_box]
mins = [min((v[i] for v in world)) for i in range(3)]
maxs = [max((v[i] for v in world)) for i in range(3)]
dims = [maxs[i] - mins[i] for i in range(3)]
if max(dims[0], dims[1]) > 38.001 or dims[2] > 18.001:
    raise RuntimeError('Envelope exceeded: ' + str(dims))
bpy.ops.wm.stl_export(filepath=out, export_selected_objects=True)
print({'exported': out, 'object': body.name, 'triangles': tris, 'non_manifold_edges': nonman, 'bounds_mm': {'min': [round(x, 4) for x in mins], 'max': [round(x, 4) for x in maxs], 'dimensions': [round(x, 4) for x in dims]}, 'volume_mm3': round(vol, 2), 'construction': {'scallops': '6 x R8 at center radius 24.75, phases 0..300 deg', 'nominal_min_grip_diameter_mm': 33.5, 'hub_mm': '12 diameter, visible z16..18; 0.2 hidden union overlap', 'dots': '12 spherical caps, 1.2 diameter x 0.35 high at radius 13.5', 'socket': 'R3.2 clipped x>=-2.4, rear-open z0 to blind end z10', 'minimum_socket_roof_mm': 6.0, 'rounding': 'body perimeter and hub rim nominal R1 (segmented bevel)'}, 'unresolved': ['Nominal rounds and circular features are tessellated approximations.', 'Fit, torque strength, PETG shrinkage, support need and print outcome remain unverified.', 'Hub-root blend and slicer/package/profile checks remain for later review.']})
